intent: Moving an agent onto its own badge takes away the access it inherited, so the order is: move it to its own badge (which opens nothing yet), grant back only what it needs (run queries, read customer data), then remove the broad access, leaving the shared login with no users. Stopping after the first step leaves an agent that greets you but fails to read.

mandatory: Exactly three cards of identical size in one row, joined left to right by two arrows
All three cards are the same soft blue (they are all actions); the callout is soft red; the bar is light grey
Card labels are bold near-black ink (#1F2328) and may wrap onto two lines only at a space; sublabels are medium-weight near-black ink (#1F2328), the same dark color as the labels, never grey
The red box sits under the left card only, never touching it, and never overlaps the bottom bar
The title is bold, large, top-left and on one line
All text is large enough to read when the image is 1000px wide
The red tag text 'Stop here: reads fail' is one string in one weight, semibold near-black, on one line
The red tag's right edge is left of the arrow between the left and centre cards
The bottom bar text is semibold near-black
The gap between the bottom of the left card and the top of the red tag is clearly visible (at least 4% of the frame height)
prohibitions: NO third-party logos and NO Google logo
NO 'Vertex AI', 'Agent Engine', 'reasoning engine' or 'reasoningEngines' anywhere
NO project IDs, NO email addresses, NO 'projects/' paths, NO '@' characters
NO people, faces, hands, silhouettes or characters
NO text that is not listed in text_exact
NO check marks, ticks or crosses
NO portrait, face or person silhouette inside any icon
NO grey or light text anywhere; every sublabel is near-black
NO bold run inside the callout text
NO pointer, tail or arrow on the red box
NO red box under the centre or right card
NO green anywhere in the image
NO circle-and-shoulders avatar, head or bust drawn on the badge icon; the badge is blank apart from one stripe
alt_text: The title reads: Re-grant before you revoke. Three blue cards joined by arrows, left to right: a badge icon, Move to its own badge, Opens nothing yet; a key icon, Grant back only what it needs, Run queries, read customer data; a padlock icon, Remove the broad access, Shared login: no users left. Under the first card, a small red tag reads Stop here: reads fail. A gray bar across the bottom reads One agent, one badge.
